questions.question: A prompt describes a subject but does not specify where it should appear. What kind of control signal would help?
options: A lower-rank style adapter for the text encoder
A later diffusion timestep embedding for denoising
A larger vocabulary for describing subject locations
A spatial condition such as pose, depth, or edges
questions.explanation: A spatial condition such as a pose skeleton, depth map, or edge image supplies layout information that prose does not specify efficiently. Adding vocabulary gives more words for locations but still does not anchor exact geometry.

questions.question: How does ControlNet connect conditioning to a pretrained diffusion U-Net?
options: A text encoder projects conditions into the VAE prior
A new discriminator replaces the original U-Net decoder
A cloned encoder feeds zero-convolution skips into the frozen model
A full-model copy replaces every attention projection
questions.explanation: ControlNet freezes the pretrained base and trains a cloned encoder to read the condition; zero-convolution skip connections inject its features into the original model. Replacing the whole U-Net would discard the pretrained decoder path.

questions.question: What does zero initialization accomplish for a ControlNet side path?
options: It starts as a no-op before learning a conditioning delta
It forces the generator output to remain exactly zero
It initializes all LoRA matrices to full rank
It deletes the original U-Net weights before training
questions.explanation: Zero-initialized convolutions make the side contribution zero at the start, so the output initially matches the frozen base; training can then learn a conditioning delta. This does not zero the base model’s own output.

questions.question: For a frozen d×d weight matrix, how many trainable parameters does a rank-r LoRA delta use?
options: 2d²r parameters
dr² parameters
d² parameters
2dr parameters
questions.explanation: A rank-r adapter stores A with r×d entries and B with d×r entries, totaling rd+dr=2dr trainable parameters. A dense d² update is the full-matrix alternative rather than the low-rank delta.

questions.question: An artist needs an exact pose and canvas layout while keeping the prompt style. Which tool fits the spatial requirement?
options: A style LoRA alone at high runtime weight
IP-Adapter with a reference image only
ControlNet-Openpose plus a text-conditioned base
Textual inversion of the pose description
questions.explanation: ControlNet-Openpose supplies the pose and layout constraint, while the text-conditioned base retains the prompt’s style and content. A LoRA mainly adjusts semantic style or subject and does not by itself enforce an exact spatial pose.

questions.question: Two ControlNets at weight 1.0 each overshoot the desired conditioning. What adjustment follows the lesson’s safe default?
options: Set both side-network gates permanently to zero
Merge both control maps into the text tokens
Raise each weight to preserve the frozen base
Reduce their combined weight toward about 1.0
questions.explanation: Two controls each at weight 1.0 sum to about 2.0 and can overshoot. The lesson suggests a combined weight around 1.0 as a safe starting point, so reducing their joint strength addresses the interaction.
